name: OPNsense MCP
description: One of several OPNsense MCP servers, chosen here for how seriously it treats the risk of an agent misconfiguring a firewall: read-only by default, and write operations use OPNsense's savepoint mechanism, a 60-second countdown that auto-reverts the change unless explicitly confirmed. Also supports declarative plan/apply workflows for VLANs, firewall rules, DHCP, DNS blocking, and HAProxy.
